desc: Live test of the decoded post-upload interface power request. RUN 2026-08-04 (fable, lease released healthy, evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-trackpad-v2-power-request-accepted.md): the 9-byte v2 form is ACCEPTED on first try -- all four 0x40 messages (off/on x will/has) returned 0 (zero 'command 0x40 failed' lines, v1 fallback never fired), the coprocessor consumed the CBOR image ('bootloader.c:522: New AFE[0] cbor image received', so DMA reachability through mtp_dart is positively confirmed), and the touch pipeline came up 260 ms after open(): 'Touch interface ready' / 'Touch MT ready'. open() succeeds where it returned rc=1 pre-patch; a second open does not re-upload and stays healthy. Unattended watch: bytes=0 events=0 -- the expected null with no finger present, NOT evidence of an above-transport gap. REMAINING (the second half of PASS): a human finger during a watch window; CJ runs 'busybox sh /bin/t6040-input-report watch /dev/input/event0 60' on any patched image and touches the pad -- expect bytes>0, events>0 plus a hex dump. If a real finger still yields events=0, the gap is above the transport and magicmouse_raw_event_mtp's 46+N*30 length filter is the next decode target. ROOT CAUSE (evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-trackpad-post-upload-reset-contract.md): comm command 0x40 is the MTP coprocessor's interface POWER request, not a reset; J614s MTP firmware (AppleMTPFirmwareMac-5340.61.4~438, SDK 25F63, self-identified again on this boot) implements ONLY the 9-byte v2 two-phase form and rejects the old 4-byte v1 form on the length check with 0xE00002C2. ARTIFACT: patches/t6040-dockchannel-hid-reset-contract.patch applied after t6040-dockchannel-trackpad-fw.patch via TRACKPAD_RESET_CONTRACT=1; Image-trackpad-reset-contract two-build byte-identical (80c15f58). Run fixture: default t6040-j614s-dcuart.dtb (tpmtfw node present, NVMe disabled) + initramfs-dcuart-trackpad-230.cpio.gz (init scripts/t6040-init-dcuart-trackpad-230 with the mandatory Norwegian keymap, reporter at /bin/t6040-input-report, exception blob a1f4131d), image-preflight OK, maxcpus=1. SCOPE/SAFETY unchanged: ticket-126 volatile-upload exception for blob a1f4131d ONLY -- volatile DMA, no flash, no persistent write; no SMC/SPMI/PMU/charger/NVRAM/firmware write; storage-disabled RAM root. STOP on SError, DART fault, firmware panic, unexpected reset, or console loss. RECOVERY: sanctioned warm reboot; RAM root leaves nothing persistent.
